_read_me: Hard parts and shipping. Prices are in dollars. The checkout reads this file, so the price here is what customers pay. Shipping numbers are starting guesses: change them to what it really costs you to ship.
_options_how_to: To sell a part in different versions, give it an options list: [{ "label": "Kit name", "price": 180.00, "shipping": 15.00 }, ...]. Customers pick from a dropdown and pay that option's price. shipping on an option is optional; leave it off to use the part's shipping. Keep each label unique.

shipping.merchNote: One flat charge when the cart has any merch, no matter how many shirts.
shipping.partsNote: Each hard part adds its own shipping below, times the quantity.
